svg.title: A seasonal worker's route between two family homes appears as duplicate residence.
svg.desc: At a market stall, a worker packs an indigo-and-cream checked travel bundle for a normal seasonal move. Riju's paper route shows one person using two family homes at different times, while the Grid splits the journey into suspicious red residence nodes.
svg.text: Page 34, panel 1 · High oblique view across a market stall and the worker's simple travel record

text.tspan: A normal seasonal move between family homes is
classified as duplicate residence and possible
